ravi (sec-eng): Heads-up: tenant `zenlabs` provisioning started failing with SCIM 403s. Logs show KMS InvalidCiphertext while decrypting extId.
lin (idp-platform): Can you paste the sanitized error? 403 on SCIM usually means decrypt or mapping problem.
ravi (sec-eng): Log snippet:
```
2026-05-18T11:02:05Z ERROR provisioner: PATCH /Users -> 403 {"detail":"forbidden: decrypt extId failed: InvalidCiphertextException"}
2026-05-18T11:02:05Z DEBUG kms: decrypt attempted with context {"extId":"acct:zenlabs:eng", "meta_v":"3"} -> InvalidCiphertext
```
harper (infra): KMS audit shows reject with attempted context meta_v=2 also. Looks like mixed contexts in queue. Any recent onboarder change?
lin (idp-platform): We landed a metadata canonicalization tweak yesterday that bumped meta_v. Some queued jobs used the old logic. Plan: add decrypt-compatibility: try current context, fallback to previous meta_v, fallback to old key alias. Also emit metric `scim.decrypt.fallback`.
ravi (sec-eng): Also propose fallback behavior: if decrypt fails after fallbacks, create user with `role=readonly` and set audit flag `scim.extid_unverified=true` instead of failing the entire PATCH. Need audit log for compliance.
harper (infra): Will cut a tenant-specific canary to enable probe-mode for zenlabs and monitor `scim.provision.fail` and `scim.provision.fallback` for 15m. I'll avoid key rotations until backfill completes.
ops-bot: deploy started: deploy-2026-05-18-probe-zenlabs (PR #4567)
lin (idp-platform): After canary, we'll reprocess backlog with compatibility decrypt and re-encrypt extIds to canonical context, then retire legacy ciphertexts. Also add XML attr-whitespace normalization test to onboarding suite to prevent future meta_v churn.
ravi (sec-eng): Created incident INC-2026-0216, severity=P2. Linking logs and ciphertext samples. Thanks team.
